scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Brasilis^000000, a country as passionate as the sun.
If you have any questions, please ask me.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
歡迎來到^8B4513巴西^000000，這個如太陽般熱情的國度。
有什麼問題，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Where can I guide you?

[Brasilis Guide]
The Brasilis Hotel is located just above, ^FF3355+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
巴西酒店就在上方，小地圖上的^FF3355+^000000標記處。
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Do you want to go through the rough jungle? You can take a 
Jungle Cable here ^CE6300+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
想穿過崎嶇的叢林嗎？
您可以在小地圖上的^CE6300+^000000標記處乘坐叢林纜車。
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The pride of Brasilis, the world scale Art Museum is at ^A5BAAD+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
巴西引以為傲的世界級藝術博物館，位於小地圖上的^A5BAAD+^000000標記處。
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
You can buy items for hunting at the Market here ^55FF33+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
在小地圖上的^55FF33+^000000標記處有個市場，能買到狩獵所需的物品。
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
The iconic monument of Brasilis, the Verass Monument stands at ^3355FF+^000000.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
巴西的地標——維拉斯紀念碑，位於小地圖上的^3355FF+^000000標記處。
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
我會清除您小地圖上的所有標記。
還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Brasilis Guide]
Wandering on your own is always the best way to explore. Anyway, take care.
scripts.translation:
[巴西向導]
想探索一座城，自己四處走走總是最好的辦法。
總之，請多保重。
